description: This file contains unit tests for the Tag class within the blogging post feature of the Goteo application, including tests for creation, validation, and deletion of Tag instances.

classes.name: TagTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the functionality of the Tag model in the blogging post system.

methods.name: testInstance
methods.description: Creates an instance of the Tag class and asserts if it is correctly instantiated.

methods.name: testValidate
methods.description: Tests the validation method of a Tag instance, expecting it to be invalid and not saved.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new Tag, validating it, saving it, retrieving it, and then deleting it.

methods.name: testNonExisting
methods.description: Tests behavior when attempting to retrieve and delete a Tag that has been deleted.
